### CVE-2004-0637
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2005-04-14 | Updated: 2024-08-08 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 24567: Oracle Database Server 8.1.7/9.0.x - ctxsys.driload Access Validation (remote/multiple, 2004-09-03, verified=1)

Oracle Database Server 8.1.7.4 through 9.2.0.4 allows local users to execute commands with additional privileges via the ctxsys.driload package, which is publicly accessible.

### CVE-2004-1707
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2005-02-26 | Updated: 2024-08-08 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 24335: Oracle9i Database - Default Library Directory Privilege Escalation (local/unix, 2004-07-30, verified=1)

The (1) dbsnmp and (2) nmo programs in Oracle 8i, Oracle 9i, and Oracle IAS 9.0.2.0.1, on Unix systems, use a default path to find and execute library files while operating at raised privileges, which allows certain Oracle user accounts to gain root privileges via a modified libclntsh.so.9.0.

Affected:
- n/a / n/a: affected n/a

### CVE-2004-1774
- Assigner: mitre | Published: 2005-04-19 | Updated: 2024-08-08 | Max CVSS: None
- CWE: n/a
- Exploit-DB 25397: Oracle Database 10.1 - MDSYS.MD2.SDO_CODE_SIZE Buffer Overflow (remote/multiple, 2005-04-13, verified=1)

Buffer overflow in the SDO_CODE_SIZE procedure of the MD2 package (MDSYS.MD2.SDO_CODE_SIZE) in Oracle 10g before 10.1.0.2 Patch 2 allows local users to execute arbitrary code via a long LAYER parameter.
